subject: CHEMISTRY
purpose: Bind visual obligations at the level they are actually owed: the individual lesson and the individual question. A product that realizes fifteen primitive kinds somewhere is not compliant if one classification or mole question is still text-only, so obligations are counted per content reference and not globally.
known_limitations: The nine quantitative and classification families added with this profile are registered as RENDERER_PENDING_FAIL_CLOSED in the C-H primitive registry. When a future corpus binds one of them, the obligation is recorded as UNREALIZED and the candidate counter drops below the required total; nothing is substituted. This mirrors how COEFFICIENT_SUBSCRIPT_CONTRAST already behaves in PR #322 when its capability supplies no notation tokens.
